name: zhihu/web/user-articles
description: Retrieves articles posted by a specific Zhihu author using their user identifier. Supports sorting by post date or upvotes alongside pagination controls.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Zhihu User Articles API Returns a page of articles written by one Zhihu member, with titles, excerpts, full HTML content, vote and comment counts, and timestamps. The only required input is the member's `user_url_token`, such as `excited-vczh`. ## Use cases - Build a feed of new long-form posts from a chosen Zhihu author. - Rank an author's articles by `voteup_count` to find their most upvoted work. - Archive an author's article titles, links and cover images for a content audit. - Track comment and favorite counts on an author's articles to compare engagement. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/user-articles" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"user_url_token": "excited-vczh"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `user_url_token` | string | Yes | User ID | | `limit` | string | No | Number of articles per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | | `sort_type` | string | No | Sort Type | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": [ { "admin_closed_comment": false, "article_type": "normal", "author": { "avatar_url": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-ada18a9354a3831171306f2c7ce20aaf_l.jpg?source=d16d100b", "avatar_url_template": "https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-ada18a9354a3831171306f2c7ce20aaf.jpg?source=d16d100b", "badge": [], "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "" }, "gender": -1, "headline": "", "id": "0970f947b898ecc0ec035f9126dd4e08", "is_advertiser": false }, "can_comment": { "reason": "", "status": true }, "comment_count": 28, "comment_permission": "all", "content": "

思路已经有了，也开始做了。

早期GacUI为了跨平台精心设计了…", "content_need_truncated": false, "copyright_permission": "need_review", "created": 1705652701, "endorsements": [ { "background_color": { "alpha": 0.1, "group": "GBL01A" }, "elements": [ { "content": "创作声明: 内容包含剧透", "font_color": { "alpha": 1.0, "group": "GBL07A" }, "font_size": 13, "is_bold": true, "max_line": 1, "type": "TEXT" } ], "sub_elements": [ { "elements": [ { "content": "创作声明: 内容包含剧透", "font_color": { "alpha": 1.0, "group": "GBL07A" }, "font_size": 13, "is_bold": true, "max_line": 1, "type": "TEXT" } ] } ], "sub_elements_type": "DESCRIPTION" } ], "excerpt": "思路已经有了，也开始做了。早期GacUI为了跨平台精心设计了一套隔离层，可以把操作系统和渲染器的细节正交地隔离掉，后来在移植到macos和linux的时候，得到…" } ], "need_force_login": false, "paging": { "is_end": false, "is_start": true, "next": "http://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/members/excited-vczh/articles?user_url_token=excited…", "previous": "http://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/members/excited-vczh/articles?user_url_token=excited…", "totals": 147 } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id / data[].title` | The article ID and the article title. | | `data[].url` | Link to the article on the Zhihu column site. | | `data[].excerpt / data[].content` | A short preview and the article body. Both can contain HTML tags and may be cut off. | | `data[].created / data[].updated` | Creation and last update times as Unix timestamps in seconds. | | `data[].voteup_count / data[].comment_count` | Number of upvotes and number of comments on the article. | | `data[].reaction.statistics.favorites / data[].reaction.statistics.like_count` | Number of favorites and number of likes on the article. | | `data[].image_url` | Cover image URL for the article. It is an empty string when the article has no cover. | | `data[].author.id / data[].author.headline` | The author's ID and profile headline. | | `data[].endorsements[].elements[].content` | Label text shown with the article, such as a column name or a creator statement. | | `paging.totals / paging.is_end / paging.next` | Total number of articles for this author, whether this is the last page, and the URL of the next page. | ## Notes - Take `user_url_token` from the member's Zhihu profile URL. The example value is `excited-vczh`. - Page through results with `limit` and `offset`. The `paging.next` URL in the sample response uses `limit=20` and `offset=20`. - Set `sort_type` to `created` or `voteups` to order results by post date or upvotes. - To list the same author's answers instead, call [Zhihu User Answers](/apis/zhihu/web/user-answers). For the author's profile, call [Zhihu Web User Profile](/apis/zhihu/web/user-info). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
